ChiSiamo.title: About Us
ChiSiamo.subtitle: A passion for collecting excellence.
ChiSiamo.storyP1: Kudjo was born from the need to rise above the chaos of generic online marketplaces and social media groups. We believe that high-value collectible cards deserve the same treatment: the care and presentation of fine art and luxury goods.
ChiSiamo.storyP2: We are not a mass-market comic book shop, nor an automated marketplace. Kudjo is a select independent dealer: we curate a tight archive of pieces whose provenance is known, inspect physical conditions minutely under controlled lighting, and offer an exclusive private negotiation channel.
ChiSiamo.visionP1: This catalog represents the MVP and foundation of our ecosystem. Our long-term vision is to evolve Kudjo into a highly specialized premium auction platform, where collectors can trade elite, pre-verified lots in safety and transparency.

Legal.title: Terms & Legal Notes
Legal.subtitle: Transparency, privacy, and legal compliance in accordance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR).
Legal.disclaimerP1: Kudjo operates exclusively as a digital catalog and showcase of physical lots, owned or on consignment. This site is NOT an e-commerce platform, does not contain online payment gateways (like Stripe or PayPal), and does not offer any integrated auction or bidding service in this version.
Legal.disclaimerP2: All negotiations, sales agreements, financial transactions, and shipping occur privately, outside of the website infrastructure, via direct agreements between the buyer and the dealer (Kudjo). Kudjo disclaims all liability for payment methods chosen privately by the parties.
Legal.privacyIntro: Pursuant to Art. 13 of EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR), we inform you on how we collect and process your personal data when you interact with our platform.
Legal.controllerText: The Data Controller is Kudjo (hereinafter 'Kudjo' or 'Controller'), who can be contacted for any request or exercise of rights at the email address: privacy@kudjo.it.
Legal.dataTypeText1: - Contact data provided voluntarily: First name, last name, email address, and/or phone number entered in the contact forms ('Sell to Us', 'Inquire for Information', or newsletter subscription).
Legal.dataTypeText2: - Navigation data: IP address, device identification codes, request times, and other parameters relating to the user's operating system and IT environment, processed solely to enable technical navigation.
Legal.purposeTitle: 3. Purposes and Legal Basis of Processing
Legal.purposeText1: - Responding to user requests (contact form): The legal basis is the execution of pre-contractual or contractual measures at the request of the data subject (Art. 6.1.b GDPR).
Legal.purposeText2: - Sending newsletters and updates (where requested): The legal basis is the user's express consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR).
Legal.purposeText3: - Technical maintenance and security of the site: The legal basis is the Controller's legitimate interest in keeping its infrastructure secure and functional (Art. 6.1.f GDPR).
Legal.recipientsText: Your data will not be sold, rented, or transferred to third parties for marketing purposes. It will be processed exclusively by the Controller and by technical service providers designated as Data Processors (e.g., Vercel hosting and email service providers), strictly within the limits necessary for the website operation.
Legal.retentionText: Contact form data will be kept for as long as necessary to respond to user requests, and for a maximum period of 12 months from the last communication. Newsletter data will be kept until an unsubscription (opt-out) request is made, which can occur at any time via the link provided in the emails.
Legal.rightsText: Under the GDPR, you have the right to request from the Controller: access to your personal data, rectification, erasure (right to be forgotten), restriction of processing, objection to processing, as well as data portability. You also have the right to withdraw your consent at any time and to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority (Garante per la Protezione dei Dati Personali - www.garanteprivacy.it). You can exercise your rights by writing to privacy@kudjo.it.
Legal.cookieIntro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are and how we use them to provide you with an optimal browsing experience.
Legal.cookieTechnicalText: Technical cookies are text files stored on your device for purposes strictly related to the website functioning. Kudjo uses exclusively its own technical cookies. We do not use profiling or third-party cookies for advertising or tracking activities.
Legal.cookieDetailsText1: - NEXT_LOCALE: First-party technical cookie used to store and remember the language preference selected by the user (IT or EN). It lasts for 1 year and renews at each visit. This cookie is strictly necessary and exempt from prior consent obligations under Italian Data Protection Authority guidelines.
Legal.cookieDetailsText2: - kudjo-cookie-consent: Local browser variable (localStorage) used to record acceptance of this policy and prevent the banner from appearing on every page load.
Legal.cookieManageText: You can disable, restrict, or delete cookies by modifying your web browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, etc.). Please note that by disabling the technical cookie NEXT_LOCALE, the site may not remember your preferred language and will restore the default one at each new session.
